title: The Remediation Work-Plan Visit on Mold Remediation Jobs
content:
Every Mold Remediation job on a tier that requires a protocol carries one work-plan visit line: the remediation supervisor walks the site with the independent assessor's protocol and writes the remediation work plan the customer receives before remediation begins. The work-plan visit line is coded supervisor labor, dated the job's opened date, in the business-hours window, and booked as one visit of quantity 1 each whose rate is the line amount.

**Status in which the line is charged.** For the work-plan visit line, and only for that line, the job may be in scheduled or authorized status as well as remediating, awaiting clearance or cleared status when it is charged; the pre-removal asbestos sampling line is governed by its own schedule, and every other scope line and every equipment day still requires the job to be in remediating, awaiting clearance or cleared status when it is charged.

| On the job's records | The work-plan visit line |
|---|---|
| Tier requires a protocol | One line per job |
| Opened date | Service date of the line |
| Status scheduled, authorized, remediating, awaiting clearance or cleared | The line may be charged |
| Charge lines | Supervisor labor, quantity 1 each, rate equal to the amount |

## Booking the line: `book_mold_workplan_1501986a`

**Capability.** Records, on the named Mold Remediation job, one `supervisor_labor` charge line for the visit at which the remediation supervisor walked the site with the assessor's protocol and wrote the remediation work plan. The line is booked as quantity 1 each with the line amount as its rate, in the `business_hours` window, and the job's balance due rises by the amount. The new line is immediately visible among the job's charge lines.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then calls `book_mold_workplan_1501986a` through `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

- `mold_job_id` — the reference number of the mold remediation job the visit is billed on, read from the job lookup for this customer.
- `service_date` — the date of the work-plan visit, written YYYY-MM-DD as a calendar date with no time or time zone; an empty value is not accepted.
- `amount` — the visit charge in US dollars, a positive number with at most 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent half up; it is stored to the cent.

**Return.** A confirmation naming the new charge line's reference number, the job reference number, the charge code `supervisor_labor`, the service date (YYYY-MM-DD), the amount booked (USD, 2 decimals) and the job's new balance due (USD, 2 decimals). A reply starting with "Error:" means nothing was booked because an argument did not meet its stated format (a date not in YYYY-MM-DD form, or an amount that is not positive or has more than 2 decimal places).
